b1: Original independent interpretation request for each path. 13 paired waves, same two lanes, original untyped proposals and numerical/control inputs. No deliberately paced idle between waves; max two concurrent native roots. Do not compare campaign throughput to historical open-loop as a treatment effect.

b2_b3_pairs.b2_instructions: B2 role tools and role delegation defaults, shorter GX instructions; all other settings held
b2_b3_pairs.b2_role: B2 role tools and role delegation defaults, legacy GX instruction text; official Codex BaseInstructions unchanged
b2_b3_pairs.b3: B2 compact with capped immutable Artifacts preloaded into the original briefs

baseline: Existing 13-wave OpenAI OAuth receipts at acceptance/v3/performance/p1. No new baseline arm. B0 captures one west Run for per-response attribution only.
estimate: Matched per-run deltas plus paired totals. Report every pair and sample size. Single paired workspace per treatment has provider variance and order effects; no general causal throughput estimate.
quality: Recompute six frozen CPU observations per Run, check evaluation digests, canonical decision and evidence refs, independent reviewer denominator and actual accepted Products. Additional scientific-quality benchmark is separate.
responses: Observed response IDs from App Server and official rollouts; attribute fields only when provided. A canceled unpaid request might not surface in an OAuth rollout. Protocol peer is separate request-start evidence.
spending: Each Run bounded by original 440000 tokens/3 native Turns/2 CPU Jobs; one 900000-token workspace per paired wave. No repeat of the historical arm.
walls: Each Run created_at through durable end; first-to-last official native span, driver intervals and entire acquisition wall reported separately. Recovered B0 total wall includes observer interruption and is not the B2/B3 control.
